mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate directly reduces the risk-free rate, lowering equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 4.0%, the Federal Reserve maintains restrictive policy, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) by >0.5% from prior month signal broad consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline >0.5% from prior month
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST and RSAFS both decline >0.5% from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), accommodative monetary policy supports equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output, correlating with stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO rises for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) falling below 1300 thousand units signal housing market weakness, reducing consumer confidence and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 1300.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signal aggressive monetary tightening, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 4.0% and FEDFUNDS > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In slow-growth regimes (GDPC1 annualized growth < 1.0%), accommodative policy supports equity markets, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 annualized growth < 1.0%.
